main_text.p: rea prædominentur; feu, ut interpretatur Cl. D. Strauff. atmosphæram effe congeriem corpusculorum ex terra & aqua mixtifque corporibus extrufo- rum ((feu evectorum;) inter quas nimirum,quod fuit addendum juxta mentem Digbæi, ipfa Aeris fubftantia genuina fit interfufa,principatum præ reliquis corpusculis obtinens : Similiter dixerim, Vinum turbulentum, dum fermentatur, congeriem effe plutimorum corpusculorum quæ fæcibus infunt, inter quas interea ipfa vini fubftantia prædominatur; at interim non dixerim in vino Vacuum effe. Feruntur per Aëra particulæ terræ & aquæ furfum evectæ, uti Pifces per Aquam; qui nempe promoti, ut neutiquam fpatia vacua fubeunt, fic nec vacua fpatia poft fe relinquunt: Nempe cedunt fibi corpora, fibique viciflim in orbem fuccedunt; ut nec vacuum nec plenum occupent corpora dum promoveнтur, fed plenum fuis dimenfionibus confti- tuant.

page.notes: Several words in the first lines are set in a heavy or cramped impression; the parenthetical "((feu evectorum;)" and "evectæ" readings are doubtful. Marked words "promoveнтur" contains a Cyrillic-looking letter in the transcription and should read "promoventur"; the scan shows a hard "e" there. Half-line near the foot is faint.
